description:
A smart digital workspace to organize web apps, accounts, and tasks in one place.

Apposition is a high-speed, local-first digital workspace designed to organize web apps, sandboxed profiles, and multitasking windows into a unified spatial canvas.
Promotional Code Stacking, Expanded Free Tier & Instant Localhost Navigation
Features
- Promotional Code Stacking: Stack additional license and promotion codes directly inside Account Settings to instantly upgrade tiers, unlock more account profiles, and expand multi-device seats.
- Expanded Free Tier: Free accounts now include up to 5 workspaces and 2 separate account profiles with zero credit card required.
- Touch-Responsive Workspace Controls: Pane headers now feature touch-responsive quick actions and a dedicated focus mode for distraction-free split-screen workflows.
Improvements
- Instant Localhost & Dev Navigation: The searchbar now instantly detects local development servers, custom ports, and internal network addresses, opening them directly without redirecting to web search.
- Seamless Split Pane Transitions: Eliminated blank search flashes and URL flicker when switching focus between side-by-side panes.
Bug Fixes
- Profile Quota Status: Settings and profile menus now accurately display inactive badges only on profiles exceeding your active plan allowance.
